note: Everyday Moroto/Kotido Ŋakarimojoŋ in a young professional's voice: 'Tobuk kotoma UG' for Book, 'Toriŋ esimu ŋaren' for Call ahead, 'ŋiropiyae a esimu' for mobile money, 'ai ejokuna iyoŋ' for 'where you are comfortable'. Standard orthography with ŋ throughout (ŋituŋa, ŋiropiyae, daadaŋ, toŋolik); to- imperatives (Tolot, Toya, Toseu, Totac); ŋi-/ŋa- plurals. The four slogan verbs are Tolot. Toriamu. Topangis. Toya. Because the wording leans on Ateso and Turkana cognates where a Karimojong form was not certain, verb inflections, passives and app-market words (rank, sandbox, plug-in, endpoint, wallet, entertainment) are the weakest points and are listed under uncertain; a native reviewer from Moroto or Kotido should check tone before this goes live.
